forest_tree_outline.label: forest_tree_outline
forest_tree_outline.prompt: A SINGLE horizontal distant forest treeline silhouette in 2D hand-drawn style, placed at the LOWER 30 percent of the canvas. Above the treeline the canvas is completely empty dark void color #060806 (no patterns, no other tree rows, no stacking, no repeating). Trees are distant dark greenish-black silhouettes around #1A2820, sparse and natural, only one row across the bottom. Below the treeline is also dark void #060806 (no ground drawn here, no leaves, no path). No midground, no foreground, no character, no birds, no light beams, no text, no UI, no logos, no watermarks. The treeline must be ONE single row, not three.
forest_tree_outline.notes: v2 重出: 单条树线在下方 30%

forest_light_shows.label: forest_light_shows
forest_light_shows.prompt: A horizontal 2D hand-drawn transparent overlay for forest scene. EXACTLY THREE very soft pale green diagonal sun beams in color #8FA87A, low opacity, narrow, in the upper half only, evenly distributed across the canvas. Plus THREE very small distant bird silhouettes (small, restrained, in the upper third, not the main subject). Plain dark teal-green background #060806 that will be made transparent. No trees, no full background, no character, no text, no UI, no other shapes. The light beams must be narrow and faint, not large opaque white areas. No geometric polygons, no abstract shapes, no scattered confetti-like dots.
forest_light_shows.notes: v2 重出: 3 根光柱 + 3 只小鸟

traveler_idle.label: traveler_idle
traveler_idle.prompt: A single still 2D hand-drawn character sprite, STRICT side view facing RIGHT, transparent background, body proportions head-to-height about 1 to 3.3 (chubby, compact, NOT slim, NOT elongated). Neutral adult, medium-length coat or light cloak, loose pants, simple travel boots. NO facial features drawn, no eyes, no mouth, no nose. Main color muted gray-green #6A7A6E, dark shadows #2A322C, very faint pale green rim light. Relaxed idle pose, both feet flat on the same horizontal baseline, no walking motion, complete body shown left to right with the head rightmost, no scenery, no trees, no ground, no shadow on ground, no text, no UI, no logo.
traveler_idle.notes: v2 重出: 严格 3/4 侧视、紧凑 1:3.3、齐脚基线
